label: ECB
title: ECB Rate Decision
note: Governing Council interest-rate decision at 14:15 CET, followed by the 14:45 press conference. Moves euro-area stocks, the euro and bond yields.

label: BoJ
title: Bank of Japan Rate Decision
note: Second day of the Monetary Policy Meeting; the decision comes at an unannounced time, usually around midday in Tokyo. Surprises have moved the yen and global stocks.

label: Midterms
title: US Midterm Elections
note: Congressional elections that decide the balance of power in Washington, and with it the odds of tax, spending and tariff changes.
